dedupe_keys.name: sublime material stock database of macro infrastructure in the netherlands steel concrete asphalt

description: SUBLIME is a database of the steel, concrete and asphalt stocks held in the macro-infrastructure of the Netherlands, covering transport, energy, water and utility networks. It examines 46 detailed infrastructure types grouped into highway, railway, oil and gas, water, electricity and aggregated utility categories, and gives for each the total material stock together with its material intensity and average lifetime. Version 1.1 was published on 30 September 2025 by Md Faysal Tareq, Sebastiaan Deetman and Arnold Tukker of the Institute of Environmental Sciences at Leiden University, with an accompanying article in Resources, Conservation and Recycling Advances (DOI 10.1016/j.rcradv.2025.200269). The single Excel workbook is available free on Zenodo under the CC BY 4.0 licence. Caveats: stocks are estimated from network lengths and typical material intensities, not asset-by-asset surveys, and the database is a national total without maps. It supports national scenarios of infrastructure maintenance, replacement and ageing, and the material and emission cost of keeping the stock in service; a related record is the MAT_STOCKS global material stocks database.
